`goto` via the map = **map compass** (`map_walk`): road route on the map → 8-unit `go-world` hop toward the route point ahead → reading → dead-reckon the map position (0.3 units/px) → look at the map again every 3 hops, when stuck, or after a scene change; scene borders are walked through

**Trail:** consecutive readings with a real move = proven walk, both ways, half cost; never-walked straight lines cost length + 5. **Back links:** a traced crossing F → S gives S → F (walk from S's arrival point against her first move). **Walls** keep the stuck direction. **Fast stuck:** all clicks refused = `BLOCKED` with no reading; `failed to pathfind` gives the exact refused point. **Vision:** a failed walk / map hop / uncalibrated area → `NEED_VISION exit` → `wf teach exit <cell>` walks there; a real move becomes a proven walk + the blocked direction a wall

The vision question is **paired with the layers**: screenshot + blue road mask, green proven trail, red walls/refused clicks, yellow planned direction, coordinate ticks; the question is about the **next step toward the goal** (not "an exit"): it names the goal (place, distance/direction, the open run's task) and numbers the next route points; the model answers a click `wf teach step X:Y` near Tara on open ground/road toward the goal (`wf ask-step <place>` asks on purpose). Never-walked lines longer than one hop (8 units) cost 2× per extra unit

| L121 | The capture path (`grab`) is cheap and stateless | D183 crash: the replant run went silent after one watering, then the game log stopped at our next focus/click (19:23) and the game was relaunched at 19:45. Measured in the daemon: `grab()` leaked ~8 MB per call (one full frame), so `scan()` grew the daemon ~20 MB per call (483→867 MB in 15 scans), and every look/state/scan added more. Cause: `bytes(CGDataProviderCopyData(...))` never freed the CFData. Fix: `Image.frombuffer(..., memoryview(data), ...)` inside `objc.autorelease_pool()` → +0 MB/call; scan plateaus ~550 MB over 40 calls. The leak fits the hang but is not proven to be what killed the game (no crash or jetsam report). |
